acceptance.claimBoundary: Acceptance proves receipt-bound comparison behavior only; design selection and integration remain separate human and AgentFlow decisions.
evidenceRequired: Two contract-equivalent variants are compared using digest-verified AgentFlow receipts.
Tests reject tampered, stale, incomplete, ownership-escaping, and validation-incomplete variants.

completionCriteria: A read-only adapter consumes actual AgentFlow receipts for at least two isolated, contract-equivalent variants without starting AgentFlow.
The adapter verifies design-contract, validation-plan, task, source-revision, handoff, build-receipt, and evidence digests before a variant is eligible.
Failed, partial, stale, ownership-violating, or validation-incomplete execution is ineligible.
Independent critiques and dissent remain visible and cannot be averaged away into a false consensus.
A recommended leader remains evidence for a separate human selection and Proofloom cannot integrate the selected variant.
Tests prove variant-name neutrality, isolation, contract equivalence, receipt tamper rejection, and the human-selection boundary.
nonObjectives: Do not execute variants from Proofloom.
Do not select or integrate a winner automatically.
Do not treat deterministic comparison as causal or production outcome proof.
objective: Operationalize governed design-arena evaluation using verified AgentFlow receipts while preserving human selection and AgentFlow integration authority.
title: Connect design-arena evidence to AgentFlow receipts
